about.label: PLAYER BIO
about.paragraph: I'm Rudra Narayan Mondal — a software engineer at CRTDH Lab, IIT Kharagpur, and an MS (research) scholar in nanoscience. I build machine-learning models for biological data, and the algorithms that turn point-of-care device images into biomarker readings. I came up through the MERN stack shipping full-stack apps, then followed my curiosity into diagnostics, edge AI and computational drug discovery.
about.caption: SOFTWARE ENGINEER · IIT KHARAGPUR, INDIA.
about.short: I'm Rudra Narayan Mondal, a software engineer at CRTDH Lab, IIT Kharagpur, and an MS (research) scholar. I build machine-learning models for biological data, and the algorithms that turn point-of-care images into biomarker readings. MERN by trade, scientist by curiosity.

manual.label: PLAYER'S MANUAL · P.01
manual.definition: 1. An engineer who *teaches machines to read biology*, ships software that real people depend on, and treats every layer — *from pixel to protein* — as his responsibility.
manual.definition2: 2. (arcade slang) Player one. Known to respawn at 3 a.m. with a working build.
